summary: AI Era Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Financial Advisory Agreement with Craft Capital Management LLC for advisory services related to a proposed direct listing on NYSE American. The fees include a non-refundable $570,000 cash fee (with $35,000 prepaid), ~$300,000 in advisor shares based on the listing price, and up to $150,000 expense reimbursement. The agreement terminates a prior underwriting engagement. It is a routine advisory engagement, not a special situation event. No definitive terms, pricing, or timeline are set for the direct listing itself.
